# `adt cts`

CTS (Change and Transport System) operations

```bash
adt cts [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command          | Description                                           |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt cts search` | Search transport requests                             |
| `adt cts tree`   | Transport tree operations (uses search configuration) |
| `adt cts tr`     | Transport request operations                          |

## `adt cts search`

Search transport requests

```bash
adt cts search [options]
```

**Options**

| Option               | Description                                           | Default |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-u, --user <user>`  | Filter by owner (* for all)                           | `*`     |
| `-t, --type <type>`  | Filter by type: workbench/customizing/copies or K/W/T | `*`     |
| `-m, --max <number>` | Maximum results to display                            | `50`    |
| `--json`             | Output as JSON                                        |         |

## `adt cts tree`

Transport tree operations (uses search configuration)

```bash

```

List transports using search configuration


**Options**

| Option               | Description                | Default |
| -------------------- | -------------------------- | ------- |
| `-m, --max <number>` | Maximum results to display | `50`    |
| `--json`             | Output as JSON             |         |

### `adt cts tree config`

View or edit search configuration

```bash
adt cts tree config [options] [command]
```

**Options**

| Option       | Description             | Default |
| ------------ | ----------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`     | Output as JSON          |         |
| `-e, --edit` | Open interactive editor |         |

**Subcommands**

| Command                   | Description                                                      |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt cts tree config set` | Update search configuration (only specified options are changed) |

#### `adt cts tree config set`

Update search configuration (only specified options are changed)

```bash
adt cts tree config set [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                   | Description                                                                 | Default |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-u, --user <username>`  | Filter by user (use * for all users)                                        |         |
| `--workbench <bool>`     | Include workbench requests (true/false)                                     |         |
| `--customizing <bool>`   | Include customizing requests (true/false)                                   |         |
| `--copies <bool>`        | Include transport of copies (true/false)                                    |         |
| `--modifiable <bool>`    | Include modifiable requests (true/false)                                    |         |
| `--released <bool>`      | Include released requests (true/false)                                      |         |
| `--date-filter <preset>` | Date filter preset (0=Week, 1=2Weeks, 2=4Weeks, 3=3Months, 4=Custom, 5=All) |         |
| `--from-date <date>`     | From date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD)                                          |         |
| `--to-date <date>`       | To date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD)                                            |         |

## `adt cts tr`

Transport request operations

```bash
adt cts tr [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                      | Description                                                            |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt cts tr list`            | List transport requests                                                |
| `adt cts tr get`             | Get transport request details                                          |
| `adt cts tr objects`         | List objects in a transport request with optional filters              |
| `adt cts tr create`          | Create a new transport request                                         |
| `adt cts tr set`             | Update transport request (non-interactive, for scripting)              |
| `adt cts tr delete`          | Delete transport request (with mandatory confirmation)                 |
| `adt cts tr release`         | Release transport request                                              |
| `adt cts tr reassign`        | Change the owner of a transport request                                |
| `adt cts tr source-manifest` | Build a metadata-only exact source manifest for one or more transports |
| `adt cts tr metadata`        | Get typed CTS request/task metadata for automation                     |
| `adt cts tr task`            | Transport task operations                                              |

### `adt cts tr list`

List transport requests

```bash
adt cts tr list [options]
```

**Options**

| Option               | Description     | Default |
| -------------------- | --------------- | ------- |
| `-m, --max <number>` | Maximum results | `50`    |
| `--json`             | Output as JSON  |         |

### `adt cts tr get`

Get transport request details

```bash
adt cts tr get [options] <transport>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument      | Description                         | Default |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<transport>` | Transport number (e.g., TRLK942971) |         |

**Options**

| Option      | Description                       | Default |
| ----------- | --------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`    | Output as JSON                    |         |
| `--objects` | Show list of objects in transport |         |

### `adt cts tr objects`

List objects in a transport request with optional filters

```bash
adt cts tr objects [options] <transport>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument      | Description                         | Default |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<transport>` | Transport number (e.g., DEVK900001) |         |

**Options**

| Option                       | Description                                                                   | Default |
| ---------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--obj-func <func>`          | Filter by object function code (comma-separated, e.g. D or D,K). Default: all |         |
| `--pgmid <pgmid>`            | Filter by program ID (comma-separated, e.g. R3TR or R3TR,LIMU). Default: all  |         |
| `--type <types>`             | Filter by object type (comma-separated, e.g. CLAS,TABL). Default: all         |         |
| `--also-transport <numbers>` | Additional transport numbers to merge (comma-separated)                       |         |
| `--json`                     | Output as JSON                                                                |         |

### `adt cts tr create`

Create a new transport request

```bash
adt cts tr create [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                                      | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `-d, --description <desc>` | Transport description                            |         |
| `-t, --type <type>`        | Transport type: K (Workbench) or W (Customizing) | `K`     |
| `--target <target>`        | Target system                                    | `LOCAL` |
| `--project <project>`      | CTS project                                      |         |
| `--no-interactive`         | Skip interactive prompts (requires -d)           |         |
| `--json`                   | Output as JSON                                   |         |

### `adt cts tr set`

Update transport request (non-interactive, for scripting)

```bash
adt cts tr set [options] <transport>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument      | Description                         | Default |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<transport>` | Transport number (e.g., TRLK900123) |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description                      | Default |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-d, --description <desc>` | New transport description        |         |
| `--target <target>`        | New target system                |         |
| `--from-json <file>`       | Load full payload from JSON file |         |
| `--json`                   | Output result as JSON            |         |

### `adt cts tr release`

Release transport request

```bash
adt cts tr release [options] <transport>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument      | Description                         | Default |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<transport>` | Transport number (e.g., TRLK900123) |         |

**Options**

| Option          | Description                                 | Default |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--skip-check`  | Skip pre-release validation                 |         |
| `--release-all` | Release all tasks first, then the transport |         |
| `-y, --yes`     | Skip confirmation prompt                    |         |
| `--json`        | Output result as JSON                       |         |

### `adt cts tr reassign`

Change the owner of a transport request

```bash
adt cts tr reassign [options] <transport> <new-owner>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument      | Description                         | Default |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<transport>` | Transport number (e.g., TRLK900123) |         |
| `<new-owner>` | SAP username of the new owner       |         |

**Options**

| Option            | Description                                         | Default |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-r, --recursive` | Also reassign all modifiable tasks of the transport | `false` |
| `--json`          | Output result as JSON                               |         |

```bash

```

**Arguments**
